LESSON: PHONICS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Phonics

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Phonics. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. match unfamiliar letters to shapes sound -to- letter matches per week. to letter sounds for reading Variations to this suggestion should be made by increasing the number of sounds in instances where learners can comfortably make more letter-sound matches to take care of differentiated curriculum and learning. For those struggling with some letter-sound matches, opportunities for more practice should be created. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

2. Explain Phonics to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Phonics important to you?
